text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex can't easily explain why she was preferred over you. An all-female panel isn't evidence of bias — in newsrooms and public broadcasters it's an unremarkable composition, and panels don't systematically favour their own sex. Raising it would likely read as grievance-hunting and weaken your credibility on stronger points.

Your stronger ground is elsewhere. The stated reason — "strong experience of digital media" — may rest on an assumption that someone with fifteen years, five of them as deputy, is less digitally current. If that assumption tracked your age rather than evidence, that's worth examining.

Chase the written explanation in writing, with a deadline and a reference to their own recruitment policy.
